paite: Saltan akum sawmthumna, akha lina, huai kha ani ngana ah Kebar lui a saltangte lak a ka om lai in hichi ahong hi a, van hong kihong a, Pathian kilakna ka mu hi.
heading: Ezekiel In Pathian Amuhna Masa / (1.1-7.27) / Pathian Laltutphah

paite: Huai kha ani ngana ah, huai tuh kumpipa Jehoiakin saltan akum ngana ahi,
Kaldai gam a Kebar lui a Buzi tapa siampu Ezekiel kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a: huai ah TOUPA khut atung ah a-om hi.
Huan ka en a, ngai in, mallam a kipan huihpi thupi mahmah ahong kuan a, meipi asah a sah, kuang zoizoi, akim tengteng tanvak puappuap asung mei laitak ah sik am bang a am a-om hi.
Huchi in huai lai a kipan in thil hing li kibatpih ahong pawtkhia ua, akimuhdan uh hichibang ahi a: Mihing batna anei ua,
mai li anei chiat ua, kha li anei chiat uhi.
Akhete uh atang a; akhepek nuailam uh bawngnou khepek bang ahi a; huan dalte mahmah bang in avakkhe zualzual uhi.
Apang lite ua akha nuai uah mihing khut bang anei ua; huchi in ali un amel uleh akhate uh hichibang in apu uhi:
Akhate uh akizom a; apai un leng akihei ngei kei ua, amazawn uah apai chiat uhi.
Amel un akibatpihte mihing mel bang ahi a, ali un ataklam pang uah humpinelkai mel apu ua, ali un aveilam pang uah bawngtal mel apu ua, ali un muvanlai mel apu nawn ua, amel uh huchibang ahi.
Huan akhate uh azakkhia ua, akha nihte un akizak zom chiat ua, nih in apumpi uh akhuh uh.
Malam ah apai chiat ua, kha paina lam ding ah apai ua, apai un leng akihei ngei kei uhi.
Thil hingte lak ah suangkuangthei ampha bang, meisel bang mai asuk leh tou in apai a; meibel a-ampha mahmah a, mei a kipan khophia ahong suakkhe zualzual hi.
Thil hingte khophe zualzual bang in avialtai uhi.
Huan thil hingte ka et lai in, ngai in, thil hingte zul ah amel lite uh a ding in lei ah kangtalai liim khat zel ka mu hi.
Kangtalai khe leh atatdan beril suang zia bang mai in alang a, ali un latdan khat anei ua, alatdan uh leh atatdan uh kangtalai liim khat sung a kangtalai liim dang om bang ahi hi.
Apai chiang un sik li in apai thei ua, apai un leng akihei ngei kei uh.
Akangtalai liim kual sangtak leh mulkimhuaitak ahi a; ali un akual teng mit in adim uhi.
Huchi in thil hingte apai chiang un azul uah kangtalai peite apai sam uhi; thil hingte lei a kipan dopkang a a-om uleh kangtalai liimte leng dopkang in a-om sam uhi.
Kha apai utna lam peuhmah ah apai ua; huai lam a kha apai zel ziak in; huchi in kangtalai liimte azul uah dopkang in a-om ua, thil hing kha kangtalai liimte ah a-om hi.

Huaite apai chiang un hiaite apai uhi; huaite adin chiang un hiaite adingh ua; huaite lei a kipan a dopkang a a-om chiang un kangtalai liimte amau zul ah dopkang in a-om ua, kangtalai liimte ah thil hingte kha a-om hi.
Thil hingte lutung ah van kibatpih a-om a, kristal vak bang a te mulkimhuaitak alutung uah akiphalh zeizoi hi.
heading: Pathian Thupina Muhna

paite: Van dum nuai ah akha uh akop khat thil hing dangte sun in azak ua, akha uh kop khat in apumpi uh akhuh uhi.
Huan alen chiang un akha ging uh tui tampi mahmah ging bang, bangkim hihtheipa aw bang mai, mipi ging vengvung husa, sepaihhon husa bang mai in ka za a; adin uleh akha uh akaisak uhi.
Alutung ua vansin tung ah aw ahong om a, adin uleh akha uh akaisak uhi.
Huan alutung ua vansin tung ah laltutphah bang, sapphir suang bang mai a kimu a-om a; huai laltutphah batpih tung ah mihing bang a kilang a-om hi.
Akawng chiang tunglam sik hal-ap bang mai in ka mu a, akawng hileh kilawm chiang nuailam mei bang mai hi in ka mu a, avak kimvel lelaw hi.
Vuahzuk ni a meipi tung a sakhituihup latdan bang in akim vak alang hi. Hiai TOUPA thupina latdan bang ahi. Huan ka muh in akhup in ka puk a, thugenpa aw ka za hi.
